### Forgotten Island

#### Thu 29 Oct

While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

### Blue Film

#### Thu 29 Oct to Thu 5 Nov

Drawn by the promise of easy money and anonymous sex, queer camboy Aaron Eagle is shocked to discover a personal connection with the mysterious stranger who has paid for his company. Over the course of one night, the two men engage in a war of words and emotions as they wrestle with the impact of a tainted and shared past.

### NAZA

#### Thu 29 Oct

In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel's calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them.

### Mystery LGBTQ+ Horror Preview + Director Intro

#### Thu 29 Oct

As part of our Halloween Week, we have a preview of a new horror film that hasn't been released in UK cinemas yet! As an extra special treat, we will have a pre-recorded intro from the mystery director. What will it be? We'll give you a clue... It's LGBTQ+. If you can't catch this screening, we have a rerun on Sunday 1st November at 16:00. MEMBER FREE TICKETS ARE NOT APPLICABLE FOR THIS SCREE...

#### Thu 29 Oct

‘Live Laugh Lesbian’ is a London based dyke led collective by Alex Davenport and Sophie Nielsen. They are interested in exploring lesbian representation (and all things ridiculous and sexy) through a comedic lens with the aim of providing lesbians with an evening that makes you laugh and love being a lesbian; exactly what it says on the tin.
